ResearchProjectDef.label: thermonuclear warheads
ResearchProjectDef.description: Two-stage warheads: a fission primary ignites a secondary of depleted uranium and fusion fuel. Unlocks the Minuteman III with a W62-class thermonuclear warhead, whose blast reaches far across the map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-yield warheads
ResearchProjectDef.description: Larger secondaries and better boosting. Unlocks the Minuteman III with a W78-class warhead, whose blast sweeps the whole map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: MIRV heavy ICBMs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Multiple independently targetable re-entry vehicles on a heavy liquid-fuelled ICBM. Unlocks the RS-28 Sarmat silo and missile: over the target its bus releases ten small nuclear warheads spread across the whole map, each one a separate target for missile defense.
